cal.istruzioni: How does it work? Instructions in the settings
cal.iphone.testo: Tap Add to calendar and confirm with Subscribe. Alternatively: Settings → Calendar → Accounts → Add Account → Other → Add Subscribed Calendar, and paste the address. To get the 7:00 alert on changed days, turn off Remove Alerts in the settings of the subscribed calendar.
cal.android.testo: On a computer open Google Calendar → Other calendars → + → From URL and paste the address. On your phone, in the Google Calendar app, turn on sync for the new calendar. Google refreshes subscribed calendars slowly: a change may show up only after 24 hours. Google does not show alerts for subscribed calendars: leave notifications off in the calendar settings, so you don't get an alert every day.
cal.outlook.testo: In Outlook on the web: Add calendar → Subscribe from web, paste the address and save.
home.titolo: The page on your Home screen
home.intro: An icon on your phone that opens your school's menu directly. First choose the school, then:
home.iphone.testo: In Safari tap the Share button (the square with the arrow pointing up), then Add to Home Screen and confirm with Add.
home.android.testo: In Chrome tap the ⋮ menu at the top right, then Add to Home screen (or Install app) and confirm.
impostazioni.calendario.scegli: Choose a school first: you'll then find the address of its calendar here.
impostazioni.segnala: A wrong day, a school with the wrong menu? Open a report on GitHub, already filled in with the selected school.
piede.nota: Unofficial project, not affiliated with Dussmann Service or the City of Padova. The official menu at scuoledussmann.it/padova always prevails. Special diets and allergens are not included. The matching between schools and menus is taken from the City's documents.
